title: Residency-aware RBAC proofs & periodic review automation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Automate generation of residency-scoped access proofs for audits and wire them into the periodic access review workflow. This ticket implements the pipeline that collects RBAC assignments, SSO session traces, and SCIM provisioning deltas scoped by tenant residency (region or data center), applies retention rules, and emits signed evidence bundles and incremental exports to the compliance export lake.

Scope specifics:
- Collect effective permissions (role -> resource) for accounts and service principals, enriched with tenant residency label and retention profile.
- Correlate recent SSO/SAML session tokens and SCIM events to show last-active / last-provisioned timestamps for each principal.
- Produce per-tenant "access proof" bundles that are time-bound (e.g., 90-day window) and include cryptographic signature metadata for tamper-evidence.
- Integrate with periodic review UI (Console) to surface stale access candidates and attach proof bundles to review items.
- Provide automated export to the audit evidence pipeline (S3/GCS path) and optional push to customer-managed KMS for envelope encryption.

Out of scope: full redesign of RBAC model or SCIM schema changes. This work reads existing sources and augments the evidence pipeline and review surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: A1: For any tenant with residency tag, system can produce an access-proof bundle covering a configurable time window (start/end timestamps) containing role bindings, last SSO activity, SCIM provisioning events, and retention label.
A2: Bundles are signed with platform signing key and schema version documented; exported bundles are verifiable by the compliance team.
A3: Console lists review items generated from the same data source and links each review item to the corresponding evidence bundle URL.
A4: Exported evidence respects per-tenant retention settings and is placed under residency-specific storage prefixes.
A5: End-to-end load test demonstrates pipeline can generate proofs for 10k tenants within SLA (24h) without exceeding quota thresholds.
steps: 1) Define evidence bundle schema and signing envelope (security + compliance review).
2) Implement an aggregator service that merges role bindings + SSO traces + SCIM deltas keyed by principal and tenant residency.
3) Add residency-aware retention logic that filters/marks events per tenant policy before bundling.
4) Wire signing and storage export (with path pattern: /evidence/{residency}/{tenant}/{YYYY}/{MM}/).
5) Add Console integration: review item generator and link rendering to evidence blob.
6) Add unit/integration tests, and a small scale benchmark harness for performance validation.
7) Document runbook for on-call and how to regenerate bundles for a given tenant/time window.
